channel.title: Contracts: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New contracts filings from Korean small and mid caps.

item.title: Ascendio signed a cosmetics supply contract worth KRW 906.4m, equal to 15.31% of recent revenue, with an overseas distributor.
Kamu E&C won a KRW 29.5bn contract for the Gangbuk–Amsa water transmission connection works from the Public Procurement Service.
IPARK Hyundai Development signed a KRW 350.1bn construction contract with affiliate IPARK I&Cons for a Jinju apartment project.
HDC subsidiary IPARK Hyundai Development won a KRW 350.1bn construction contract for Jinju Dodong Block B apartments from affiliate IPARK I&Cons.
Kumho Engineering & Construction signed a KRW 175.3bn contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji depot multi-level development construction.
Hancom LifeCare signed a KRW 18.96bn contract with the Defense Acquisition Program Administration for the 10th mass production of K5 gas masks.
Dongbu Corporation signed a KRW 140.2bn contract with Seoul Housing & Communities Corporation for the Jangji Garage Multi-level Development construction.
ROBOTIS signed a KRW 3.98bn DYNAMIXEL-X supply contract with Pollen Robotics SAS of France, 10.22% of recent revenue.
Deokshin EPC signed a KRW 11.4bn contract with Samsung C&T for the Pyeongtaek Campus P5 FAB2 construction.
Protec signed a KRW 23.41bn semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with Samsung Electronics, equal to 10.2% of recent revenue.
Intekplus signed a KRW 14.6bn contract to supply semiconductor and substrate inspection equipment to takewin International Ltd for China.
Yooshin signed a KRW 63.6bn contract for feasibility study and FEED design consulting on five Hanoi urban rail lines in Vietnam.
Seojeon Electric signed a KRW 7.49bn contract with Hyundai Engineering & Construction for switchgear and distribution panels.
Jeil Technos signed a KRW 11.66bn deck construction contract with Samsung C&T for the Pyeongtaek Campus P5 FAB2 project.
Hanul Materials Science signed a KRW 1.91bn contract to supply gadolinium oxide powder to KEPCO Nuclear Fuel, equal to 14.25% of revenue.
IST signed a KRW 1.96bn contract to sell semiconductor FOUP Cleaner equipment to Amkor Technology Arizona, Inc.
CS Wind signs KRW 82.9bn wind tower supply contract with Vestas American Wind Technology for the US market.
Ilsung Construction won a KRW 46.4bn share of a Cambodian rural connectivity project from Cambodia's Ministry of Rural Development.
Imagis won a KRW 6.58bn laptop touch IC order from Cirque Corporation, equal to 49.75% of recent revenue.
NanoSilikhan Advanced Materials signed a KRW 1,397,655,000 contract to supply anti-counterfeiting security products to a Middle East government pharma security supplier.
Asicland signed a KRW 13.9bn contract to supply mass-produced custom semiconductors in Korea, equal to 19.1% of recent revenue.
Seohee Construction won a KRW 134.98bn contract for new apartment construction for the Anyang Surisan Regional Housing Association.
STX Engine signed a KRW 66.5bn contract with Defense Acquisition Program Administration for coastal surveillance radar-II initial mass production and 25 other items.
Samho Development won a KRW 33.99bn construction order from Ssangyong Engineering & Construction for Nambu Inland Railway Section 8-2 roadbed works.
KCC Engineering & Construction signed a KRW 148.5bn contract for the Gimpo Gamjeong logistics center construction project.
Sos Lab signed a KRW 8.70bn contract to develop and supply autonomous driving and Physical AI lidar to a North American big tech firm.
Namkwang Engineering & Construction won a KRW 31.66bn construction contract from Korea Water Resources Corporation for a Godeok industrial complex water supply project.
KolonGlobalCorporation won a KRW 77.7bn order to build Simmtech's Cheongju 2 plant, equal to 2.89% of recent revenue.
Kolon subsidiary Kolon Global won a KRW 77.7bn construction contract for Simmtech's Cheongju 2 plant, equal to 2.89% of revenue.
Ascendio signed a cosmetics supply contract worth KRW 929.9m with a global beauty distributor, equal to 15.70% of recent revenue.
meerecompanyIncorporated signed a KRW 2.09bn semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with Samsung Electronics, equal to 5.11% of recent revenue.
JS Link signs KRW 2.24bn long-read sequencing data production contract with Korea Research Institute of Bioscience and Biotechnology
Ecoeye signs KRW 3.65bn emissions credit sale contract with Louis Dreyfus Company Suisse SA, equal to 11.8% of recent revenue.
CyberOne signed a KRW 4.11bn contract to support operations of the National Employment Computer Network cyber security control center.
Dongbu won a KRW 190.2bn contract for apartment construction in Sangdong, Wonmi-gu, Bucheon, equal to 10.81% of recent revenue.
Kctech signs KRW 69.9bn semiconductor manufacturing equipment supply contract with SK Hynix, equal to 18.26% of recent revenue.
GigaVis signed a KRW 44.7bn contract to supply semiconductor substrate inspection and repair equipment to a Chinese substrate manufacturer.
Woniltni signed a KRW 4.39bn contract with Hanwha Power to supply a heater-performance skid retrofit, 14.82% of recent revenue.
Narae Nanotech signed a KRW 6.49bn display manufacturing equipment supply contract with BOE Display Technology for delivery in China.
Ecopro HN signs KRW 20.0bn greenhouse gas abatement equipment supply contract with Hoffman Construction for Idaho, US.
